hardware: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 / NPU Strix Halo

windows_ml.status: provider acquisition in progress; no NPU ONNX latency claimed

interpretation: NPU peak compute is not the limiting concern for one MTP step; dispatch and weight/state movement dominate.
One routed expert is already sub-millisecond on CPU when dequantized weights are resident; offloading experts individually would be a bad design.
A useful NPU graph must batch the top-10 expert work and preferably include dense attention/shared-expert/lm-head work in one persistent graph.
